title: Ridgeline density comparison
intent: Compare the distribution of real Simpsons episode IMDb ratings across three seasons in compact vertically offset layers.

ai.create: Create a three-season ridgeline chart by grouping binX on the Simpsons dataset's imdb_rating field, normalizing each season by its maximum count, and passing the prepared profiles to ridgelineY with a D3 basis curve.
ai.maintain: Change the selected seasons while keeping semantic category baselines, grouped bin lineage, normalization, labels, identity, colors, and responsive overlap geometry aligned.
